arabicExcerpts.text: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ

mainSubject.label: When the earth is levelled, pounded and crushed, and the Lord comes with angels rank upon rank while Hell is brought into view, man will remember but his remembrance will avail him nothing; he will wish he had sent good ahead for his life; on that Day none punishes as severely as His punishment and none binds as severely as His binding
